card.name: Words in fixed label phrases
card.fires_on: The word "inspected" in "Parenteral drug products should be inspected visually", and a few other stock phrase words such as "del" in the Spanish "Mantengase fuera del alcance".

modes.label: Inspect visually
modes.description: The word "inspected" in the standard injection-appearance instruction.
modes.example: Parenteral drug products should be<< inspected>> visually for particulate matter and discolor

modes.description: The word "del" in the Spanish child-safety line.
modes.example: Mantengase fuera del alcance de los niños. Medicamento Homeopatico. Venta bajo prescripcion medica. Mantengase fuera<< del>> alcance de los niños.
